chunks: And in the narration of Masʿadah ibn Ziyād, from al-Ṣādiq Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, that ʿAlī, may Allah’s blessings and peace be upon him, said:
Beware of lost property, for it is the lost possession of the believer, and it is a blaze from the blaze of Hell.

key_terms.اللُّقَطَةَ: lost property that has been found
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer whose property must be respected
key_terms.جَهَنَّمَ: Hell, the place of punishment in the afterlife
key_terms.حَرِيقٌ: a burning blaze or cause of burning punishment
key_terms.ضَالَّةُ: a lost possession belonging to someone

ai.seo_question: What does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say about taking lost property?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against taking possession of lost property unlawfully and emphasizes the sanctity of a believer’s rights. It also frames such misconduct as a cause of punishment in the afterlife, showing both a legal and moral seriousness.
